PokerNow Copilot Settings

Gemini key from aistudio.google.com/apikey or the Cloud Console (AIza… and AQ.… both work). A Cloud key must have the Generative Language API enabled, and no HTTP-referrer restriction — an extension sends none. OpenRouter (sk-or-), Naga (ng-) and OpenAI (sk-) keys still work too. Stored locally, sent only to that provider.
Gemini 2.5 Flash is the default: fast, free tier, thinking switched off so the answer fits the token budget.
